phases.name: Workspace And Org Readiness
phases.intent: Confirm the local project, Salesforce CLI, and authenticated org are available before any metadata work.
acceptance_criteria: Salesforce CLI is installed and callable as sf.
evidence: sf org display JSON output for mortagate-de

phases.name: Carlos Documentation Readiness
phases.intent: Verify the mandatory source-of-truth documents exist before Salesforce schema, Flow, Apex, LWC, or Experience Cloud implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Blueprint, architecture, requirements, risk, and data dictionary artifacts exist.
At least one DESIGN document exists for the active implementation area.
AI disclosure appears in AI-drafted documentation.

phases.name: Salesforce Metadata And Quality Readiness
phases.intent: Verify Salesforce project metadata and quality checks are ready before deployment or activation.
acceptance_criteria: Metadata can be retrieved or inspected from mortagate-de.
Apex/LWC tests and source tracking commands are wired when code exists.
Flow and component quality gates from copilot-instructions.md are represented in review evidence.

commands: sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app/main/default/objects --target-org mortagate-de --dry-run --json
sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app/main/default/classes --source-dir force-app/main/default/triggers --target-org mortagate-de --dry-run --json
sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app/main/default/lwc --source-dir force-app/main/default/staticresources --target-org mortagate-de --dry-run --json

sf project deploy start --source-dir force-app/main/default/flexipages --source-dir force-app/main/default/tabs --source-dir force-app/main/default/applications --source-dir force-app/main/default/permissionsets --target-org mortagate-de --dry-run --json
checks.notes: Piecewise is canonical per ADR-22/25. ORG PREREQUISITE (one-time, survives deploys, set 2026-07-03 via Setup > Deployment Settings): 'Allow deployments of components when corresponding Apex jobs are pending or in progress' is ENABLED on mortagate-de so the classes+triggers slice passes while the nightly SecondPassSweepBatch schedule + async jobs remain active by design (the toggle permits the deploy; it does not touch the jobs). This flag is NOT exposed in ApexSettings metadata, so it is a Setup-UI org setting, not a committable file. A genuine full-source deploy additionally requires deactivating the active Agentforce bot/planner first (release runbook item, not a gate); those types are .forceignore-quarantined per ADR-23 and excluded from the piecewise slices.

checks.command: sf apex run test --target-org mortagate-de --result-format json --code-coverage

criteria: Fault connectors exist on all DML, email, or callout elements.
SLDS tokens used instead of hardcoded colors.

evidence: sf project deploy preview JSON output
Apex test JSON output when Apex exists
LWC Jest output when LWC exists
